d: Long, flowing ash-brown hair with blunt bangs and a high ponytail tied with a white ribbon frames a youthful, mature face featuring a single visible sharp amber eye and a black eyepatch over the other. The slender build is dressed in a stylized traditional eastern outfit consisting of a cream, red, and navy blue kimono-style top with wide sleeves, a red obi sash, and a short matching pleated skirt. The look is completed with white stockings, red ribbons tied around the thighs, and navy blue greaves with gold trim. A long silver chain with a heavy metal weight and a curved blade is coiled around the body.
